text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing.
It seems she has plans to meet up with someone after this...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting, Gran!
Oh, and your Trainer's here with you too.
choice_data_list: Are the two of you heading out somewhere now?
Are you two going somewhere together now?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
We're going hunting for dream-cute goods!
Bubble-senpai apparently knows some great shops to check out!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Why don't you join in too, Trainer?
You might find some merch you really like!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'd be glad to join you.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Hum-hum-hum~♪

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come to think of it...
You're walking normally today.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's Gran's "My Rules."
Just the other day, when we went shopping together—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hup, ho, tah! ...Alright,
let's hit up a bunch of shops today!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Well of course, but... what's up? Are you playing a game or something, only stepping on the white tiles?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe!
Actually, this is a personal rule of mine!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"When you want to have fun shopping,
only step on tiles of the same color"!
It'll make for a truly special shopping trip, I'm sure♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: That's true! There were so many clothes and stationery that totally sparked my interest~.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Still, we don't have to worry about that personal rule today.
Come on, let's head to the restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this fluffy texture!
Its fluffiness level is at least 85 miles!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Isn't that one cute?
Proud of that magnificent fur coat, raised up north and all.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, is that so!
...I've decided, I'm going with this one!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! But a Siberian Husky
mascot, huh? That's kind of unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I totally thought
you'd pick the Yezo sika deer, though.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's from when we
went shopping the other day!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
A T-shirt with an Ezo deer print...
Is that the one catching your eye?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: That's right! I thought wearing this would put me in a lively mood!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever you want to get into the party mood, go for Ezo Sika deer merch!"
It's truly fever time!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Actually, she looked like she was having a lot of fun. Maybe it was thanks to her house rules.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The Ezo deer is nice too, but today I'm going with this one!
I wonder what I should name it~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with Gran Alegria purchasing the plushie,
the shopping trip came to a successful close.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your help, Bubble-senpai!
I'm so glad I asked you after all!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You can rely on me for little things like this anytime.
...Still, I can't help but wonder a little.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You know that personal rule you always follow?
You haven't kept it a single time since meeting me, have you?
choice_data_list: Come to think of it... Is something the matter?
Come to think of it... Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: No, no need to worry! I've cleared my own personal rules with flying colors!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Because—my rule was to
"never stick to my own rules"!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "When you want to feel magical, seal away your personal rules!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The whimsical, dreamy atmosphere is what makes dream-cute so special.
I just want to feel like I'm floating in a dream.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So my rule is to put aside my usual rules
and get into a fairytale mood!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was able to pick out some really cute merch!
Ehehe♪
choice_data_list: Y-you have a personal rule like that...!?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha! That's so unique!
I never would've thought of that!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that's awesome. Sticking to your own rules,
no matter what... It's really cool!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an utterly bizarre rule to set for herself...
Yet that unwavering conviction in what she decided
was quintessentially Gran Alegria.
choice_data_list: I'm glad Gran seems to be having fun
You really value every one of your personal rules, don't you?
You really treasure all of your personal rules, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an utterly bizarre rule to set for herself...
Yet that unwavering conviction in what she decided
was quintessentially Gran Alegria.
choice_data_list: I'm glad Gran seems to be having fun
You really value every one of your personal rules, don't you?
You really treasure all of your personal rules, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I made sure to stick firmly to my rules today too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I'll cherish this one too!
After all, every encounter is a once-in-a-lifetime treasure♪"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I wouldn't forget any of my personal rules!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: It's my own personal rule for making sure every day is fun, after all♪
